changelog:
v1.0.35 - ChunkGen: Server Shutdown Persistence

Feature

  • ChunkGen state saved on server stop: Progress is now saved when the server shuts down via ServerStoppingEvent, preventing progress loss on clean shutdowns.
  • Startup logging: ChunkGen now logs previous progress when the server starts: [ChunkGen] Ready. Previous progress: X chunks generated up to radius Y.

Fix

  • Version restored: Fixed production branch version that was overwritten by CI-main sanitization process.

Technical Changes

  • ChunkGenManager.onServerStopping() — Saves state and logs final position on server shutdown
  • UtilityCore.onServerStarted() — Logs ChunkGen previous progress on server start
  • UtilityCore.onServerStopping() — Calls ChunkGenManager.onServerStopping()

JAR: utility_core-26.1.2-neoforge-1.0.35.jar
